newsitem.title: UK: European cotton sees light nearby covering.
newsitem.headline: European cotton sees light nearby covering.

text.p: In the absence of any new influence on price sentiment, trading in raw cotton was again confined to the occasional covering of spinners' outstanding requirements for nearby shipment.
The range of growths available for that period remains very restricted, and the trade's asking prices have in consequence remained very firm.
The sporadic business reported from most European markets has typically involved small lots of Central Asian, various African origins, and Syrian.
